statement: Ashtakavarga is a classical point-scoring system mapping relative strength across all 12 signs: eight reference points (the seven classical planets plus the Ascendant) each contribute a fixed set of favorable house positions toward every planet's Bindu (point) total in each sign — a cross-check on strength distinct from sign dignity or house placement alone.
editorial_note: Reflects a widely-repeated interpretation found throughout standard Vedic astrological literature, exemplified by (not claimed as a verbatim quotation of) the cited source.
